messages.content:
SYSTEM items:
[0] Budget constraints require price reductions and feature compromises to stay within budget.
[1] There is a problem with a two-euro cost increase.
[2] We don't have any basic options any more.
[3] Speech recognition is expensive and not previously evaluated.

GOLD items:
[0] The design cost about EUR 25 at the start of this meeting against a EUR 12.50 production allowance. The team reduced features and the project manager later reported it within budget.
[1] The group initially disagreed about which features and controls to cut; it settled on retaining the LCD, removing speech, simplifying controls and using cheaper casing/power choices.
[2] Cost information arrived after concept/prototype work, forcing substantial rework. Participants said the financial review should have occurred before drawing; the process problem had no agreed preventive fix.
[3] The industrial designer questioned whether mixed positive/negative wording invalidated the mean score. Marketing explained the intended positive criteria and the industrial designer accepted that explanation within the meeting.

messages.content:
SYSTEM items:
[0] Power source selected: hand dynamo.
[1] Five push-buttons.
[2] One integrated scroll-wheel push-button.
[3] Case material: plastic.
[4] Menu button also functions as OK.
[5] LCD screen: one large display.
[6] Device curvature: curved.

GOLD items:
[0] Use a single-curved case, replacing the double-curved concept.
[1] Drop speech recognition while retaining the LCD and its menu-based concept.
[2] Replace the rubber casing with plastic, while retaining special colour for the design.
[3] Use one integrated scroll-wheel/pushbutton and no separate buttons, with functions accessed through the LCD; detailed click/hold/menu behavior was not fully settled.
[4] Replace kinetic power with a hand dynamo after considering a battery and other cost reductions.
